title: Support desk, assembled
sub: Route the ticket, search the docs, let the model reach for a tool if it needs one, and pause before anything costly goes out.

steps.d:
"The drain pump on my DW-300 (HLV-2205) failed under
warranty, still rattling after I replaced it once already."

steps.h: Your code asks the model for one label
Your code reads the label and picks a queue
steps.d:
label='technical' -> technical queue
(the billing and general queues were not taken this run)

steps.h: Your code searches the docs and builds one prompt
steps.d:
0.81  warranty-policy.md  §3 Warranty
0.74  parts-list.md        §2 HLV-2205
0.55  dw300-manual.md      §8 Warranty

steps.h: The model decides a tool is needed and calls it
steps.d:
→ issue_replacement(part="HLV-2205", reason="repeat failure under warranty")
(it could have answered directly instead; nothing forced this choice)

steps.h: Your code runs the tool and returns the result
steps.d:
"Replacement HLV-2205 approved, ships in 3-5 days,
no charge under warranty." [warranty-policy#3]

steps.h: The model drafts an answer using the tool result
steps.d:
"A free replacement drain pump is on its way [3],
since this is a repeat failure under warranty."

steps.h: Your code checks confidence and pauses the run
steps.d:
reason=tool_used (a replacement was approved, not just answered)
the run returns a checkpoint here; no reply is sent until
a person decides
(the direct pass-through to Ticket answered, below, was not
taken this run)

steps.h: A person reviews the paused ticket and decides
steps.d:
sees: the ticket, the retrieved sources, the tool call and its result
decides: approve

steps.h: Your code resumes and sends the reply
steps.d: "A free replacement drain pump is on its way [3] ..."
